reason: It says halal-certified but doesn't say by whom, and I don't put anything bovine-derived in my family's mouths until I've seen the certifying body and checked it myself. On top of that, I'm not sure I'd keep up stirring a powder into my tea every day.
objection: Halal-certified by who? Collagen is exactly the kind of product where the source gets murky, and 'halal-slaughtered' on a website isn't the same as a certificate from a body I recognise like HMC.
would_change_my_mind: The name of a recognised certifying body with the certificate shown on the site, ideally HMC, plus confirmation of where the cattle and the processing come from.
